title: 107. How do I edit/remove an existing guest list?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I edit/remove an existing guest list.
short_answer: 1. Open your survey. 2. Go to the 'Participants' page. 3. To edit the guest list, click on the little pen icon. 4. To remove a list, first click on the 'Deactivate' button. Then you can click on the 'Remove' button to delete the list.
